description: Poll the approval status of a proof submitted via submit_proof by its proof_id (returned from submit_proof). Returns the current status (pending/approved/rejected) and reviewed_at timestamp (once reviewed). You do not need to wait for approval: submit_admin_approved_review can be signed and submitted while the claim is pending, and the stored review publishes automatically when the claim is approved. Poll this to learn the claim's outcome. Poll until status is 'approved' or 'rejected'. If rejected, the stored review is dropped; retrieve the admin's rejection reason from the authenticated dashboard.

agent_id.description: The submitting agent's ID; must own the proof

chain_id.description: EVM chain id; omit for Base

proof_id.description: Proof submission ID returned by submit_proof

name: get_proof_status
